<issue>
Monitor stops updating after pause/play cycle

#### Description

The monitor functionality appears to stop updating messages after using the pause/play feature. When pausing and then resuming message monitoring, the display only shows a limited number of updates instead of continuing to process all incoming messages.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import can
from cantools.subparsers.monitor import Monitor

# Create a monitor instance
args = Args('tests/files/dbc/motohawk.dbc')
monitor = Monitor(stdscr, args)

# Send multiple messages with timestamps
for timestamp in range(4):
    monitor.on_message_received(can.Message(arbitration_id=496, data=b'\xc0\x06\xe0\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00', timestamp=timestamp))
    monitor.tick(1)

# Pause and resume a few times
monitor.tick(1)  # pause
monitor.tick(1)  # resume
monitor.tick(1)  # pause again

# Send more messages
for timestamp in range(5, 7):
    monitor.on_message_received(can.Message(arbitration_id=496, data=b'\xc0\x06\xe0\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00', timestamp=timestamp))
    monitor.tick(1)

monitor.run(1)
```

Expected: All 6 messages should be displayed with timestamps 0.000, 1.000, 2.000, 3.000, 5.000, 6.000

Actual: Only the first message is displayed, subsequent messages are not shown in the monitor output

The issue seems to affect the message update loop which should continue processing messages indefinitely but appears to terminate early.
</issue>
